 ✅ Official Lecce-Genoa line-ups: Stulic, El Shaarawy and Vitinha calls 👀 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Sunday's Serie A action continues with Lecce-Genoa at 18:00: a crucial clash in the battle for survival, with both teams looking to put significant distance between themselves and the bottom places.
 Lecce 0 Genoa 1 23' Genoa come into the game on the back of consecutive wins over Venezia and Juventus, while Lecce have suffered back-to-back defeats against Juventus and Frosinone.
 OneFootball Videos
 ✅ OFFICIAL line-ups
 LECCE (4-3-3): Falcone; Gallo, Tiago Gabriel , Veiga, Siebert; Maleh, Ngom, Gorter; N’Dri, Štulić, Monteiro.
 GENOA (3-4-3): Bijlow; Marcandalli, Østigård, Vásquez; Ellertsson, Wiafe, Frendrup, Traoré; Messias, El Shaarawy, Osmajić.
